scope: Same firmware selected TX/RX rates and guard, NEG/preamble1 RXPOS; no frame exclusion; 8/10MHz experimental

start_ack.payload_validation_scope: Full4096-byte readback compared with independently regenerated deterministic pattern; CRC/sequence/generation retained
start_ack.expected_payload_copy_scope: Benchmark expectation-buffer memmove bytes included in prepare_us; separate from driver DMA copy counters; not a communication-driver optimization
start_ack.timing_scope: job start through ARM, preparation, complete validation, producer drain, DISARM and session cleanup; USB and LCD excluded
start_ack.per_direction_scope: All attempted synchronous transfer calls only, including failed call; excludes producer preparation and reply validation; job_MBps is complete successful job metric
start_ack.dma_activity_scope: Cumulative module/driver counter differences before ARM/session begin through session end/DISARM; null if hook absent or counter reset detected
start_ack.wait_scope: Measured blocking call wall durations, including scheduler wake latency; overlap across workers, not subtracted from wall to infer CPU
start_ack.runtime_granularity: End snapshot follows taskYIELD; scheduler runtime counter resolution and snapshot overhead apply; final return-to-wait tail is not represented
start_ack.transaction_timing_scope: Sums of existing XferDmaInfo timings for all attempted calls, no extra timers; unreached stages remain zero; nested/overlapping: total includes all, tx includes tx_config/tx_transfer/tx_release, finish includes final guard, module waits overlap tx_transfer/rx; do not sum all fields; excludes packet preparation/validation
start_ack.phase_timing_scope: Cumulative module phase wall-time deltas before ARM/session begin through session end/DISARM; includes preemption/wake latency, not task CPU; TX wait_done plus RX wait_done overlaps dma_wait_wall_us; do not add twice; uninstrumented outer unit release not included
start_ack.cpu_scope: FreeRTOS task runtime counter deltas for producer and consumer; ESP_TIMER microseconds required; one-core equivalent worker activity/wall, not whole-chip CPU; ISR may be charged to scheduled task; excludes USB/display
